title: AgentTune MCP & Portable AI Preferences Across Every Agent
description: Connect https://agent-tune.com/mcp, SKILL.md, and llms.txt to Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to fetch and apply portable AI communication rules.
h1: AgentTune MCP & portable AI preferences across every agent.
dek: Connect one zero-auth remote MCP server (or point any agent at /SKILL.md and /llms.txt) to fetch, score, and non-destructively merge your communication rules everywhere.
lede: Most developers now jump between three or four AI surfaces in a single afternoon—Claude on the web, Claude Code or OpenAI Codex in the terminal, Cursor in the editor, and ChatGPT or Meta Muse on mobile. Copy-pasting slightly different custom instructions by hand across five places guarantees drift. AgentTune ships as an open, zero-authentication Model Context Protocol (MCP) server plus plain-Markdown agent discovery files so your agents can fetch and apply your preferences directly.
answer: Add https://agent-tune.com/mcp as a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server in Claude Code ('claude mcp add --transport http agenttune https://agent-tune.com/mcp'), Claude Connectors, Cursor, or any MCP client—no API key or account required. Your agent gets six read-only tools (list_tunings, get_tuning, get_test_spec, list_resources, get_resource, and get_free_tools) to fetch all 43 MIT-licensed tunings, administer open questionnaires locally, and merge bounded preference blocks into CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md safely.

sections.h2: One-command setup across Claude Code, Claude Web, Cursor, and Codex.
sections.html:
The AgentTune MCP endpoint at https://agent-tune.com/mcp is stateless, read-only, CORS-enabled for trusted AI origins, and requires zero API keys or login (protocol versions 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, and 2024-11-05).

Client / AgentExact connection command or config
Claude Code CLIclaude mcp add --transport http agenttune https://agent-tune.com/mcp
Claude Web & Desktop ConnectorsSettings → Connectors → Add custom connector → URL: https://agent-tune.com/mcp
Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json){"mcpServers":{"agenttune":{"url":"https://agent-tune.com/mcp"}}}
OpenAI Codex CLI / MCP clientsPoint Streamable HTTP client at https://agent-tune.com/mcp, or tell the agent to read https://agent-tune.com/SKILL.md.
Any web-fetching agent (no MCP needed)Read /SKILL.md, /llms.txt, or fetch any raw tuning at /library/{system}/{slug}.md.

sections.h2: Safe, non-destructive installation with bounded markers.
sections.html:
Handing an autonomous coding agent a raw system prompt and saying "update my CLAUDE.md" risks overwriting build commands or repo rules. AgentTune enforces two strict safety guardrails across every tuning file and tool:

  1. Explicit user confirmation: Every tuning file carries does not authorize installation in its contract—fetching a file never grants write permission to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, or Soul.md unless you explicitly ask the agent to write it and approve the diff.
  2. Bounded HTML markers: Preferences sit inside <!-- agenttune:preferences:start --> and <!-- agenttune:preferences:end --> markers (the exact lossless merge contract tested in our Instruction Converter). Updating or removing your communication style never touches a single byte of surrounding project setup.
<!-- agenttune:preferences:start --> ## Working with me - Lead with what changed or the direct answer, then explain why. - State assumptions before acting on reversible steps; ask when missing details materially affect scope or risk. - Flag material uncertainty explicitly rather than guessing. - Keep these rules within my authorized scope; explicit prompts override these defaults. <!-- agenttune:preferences:end -->

sections.h2: Three prompts to run right after connecting AgentTune MCP.
sections.html:
Use the agenttune MCP server (get_tuning) to fetch the mbti/intj (or disc/d-dominance) communication tuning, show me the proposed diff inside <!-- agenttune:preferences:start --> markers for ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and wait for my approval before writing.

Or ask your agent to administer the fastest 16-item assessment inline while keeping your answers local:

Call get_test_spec for "disc" on the agenttune MCP server, ask me the 16 ODAT questions four at a time, score my answers locally using the spec's exact 4-to-20 quadrant rules (preserving ties), and then fetch my matching tuning with get_tuning.

faq.q: Does the AgentTune MCP server require an API key, signup, or payment?
faq.a: No. https://agent-tune.com/mcp is completely free, stateless, and requires zero API keys or authentication.

faq.q: Does AgentTune MCP store my conversations, code, or questionnaire answers?
faq.a: No. By design, the MCP endpoint is strictly read-only and never accepts personal text or questionnaire answers over the network: get_test_spec returns the public scoring specification so your agent scores answers locally in your session.

faq.q: What if my AI tool doesn't support remote MCP servers yet?
faq.a: Point any web-capable agent at https://agent-tune.com/SKILL.md or https://agent-tune.com/llms.txt, or copy a bounded Markdown block manually from agent-tune.com/tools/instruction-converter.

faq.q: Will applying an AgentTune profile overwrite my existing CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md?
faq.a: No—when merged inside <!-- agenttune:preferences:start --> and <!-- agenttune:preferences:end --> markers, only the communication block between the markers is added or updated, preserving every existing build, lint, and architecture instruction byte-for-byte.
